user.title: Dashboard Studio
user.description: Dashboard Studio runs inside Home Assistant. Submit to add it. No token or server URL is required. After it is added, open Dashboard Studio Setup in the sidebar to choose devices and capabilities.

abort.use_sidebar: Open Dashboard Studio Setup in the sidebar to choose areas, devices, and capabilities. That page is limited to Home Assistant administrators.

trigger_type.dashboard_page_opened: Dashboard page was opened by a viewer
